description: Implementation of NextcloudBackend class for synchronizing notes with Nextcloud, including network status checks, note creation, update, deletion, and retrieval.

classes.name: NextcloudBackend
classes.description: A backend class for synchronizing notes with a Nextcloud server, handling network status, CRUD operations, and caching.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks the availability of the Nextcloud server, utilizing caching to reduce network calls.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on the Nextcloud server.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note on the Nextcloud server using a provided ID mapping.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note on the Nextcloud server based on the provided ID mapping.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note from Nextcloud using its ID.
